-- CREATE VIEW CALENDAR
-------------------------------
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.calendar
AS
SELECT
    *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://lakeylakey3.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) as query1;
GO

-- Create view Customer
-------------------------------
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.Customer
AS
SELECT
    *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://lakeylakey3.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Customer/*.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS query2
WHERE 
    CustomerKey IS NOT NULL; -- Este filtro eliminará las 912 filas vacías
GO
